concepts.why: The patient's facial crusted plaques, mild leukocytosis, and intradermal neutrophilic inflammation with ulceration are consistent with Sweet syndrome.
The patient's painful subcutaneous nodules and septal panniculitis with Miescher radial granulomas are consistent with erythema nodosum.
The patient's history of diverticulosis and colonic polyps, and moderate inflammation, edema, erosions, and pseudopolyps in the sigmoid colon are consistent with inflammatory bowel disease.
The patient's facial crusted plaques, mild leukocytosis, and intradermal neutrophilic inflammation with ulceration are consistent with pyoderma gangrenosum.
The patient's facial crusted plaques, mild leukocytosis, and intradermal neutrophilic inflammation with ulceration are consistent with neutrophilic dermatosis.
